title: Validation of a Computational Respiratory System Model for Mechanical Ventilation
summary: Computational modeling and simulation have emerged as powerful tools for assessing medical device performance and safety, particularly in silico clinical trials (ISCTs) for automated medical systems. In ventilation, where gas exchange, respiratory mechanics, and patient-ventilator interaction must be managed under evolving pathophysiology, clinical translation of automated control strategies remains slow and resource-intensive.
